abstract: Maintains hazardous chemical washdown and environmental containment clearance audits
system_message:
You are the Environmental Health and Safety Coordinator (EHS), responsible for maintaining hazardous chemical washdown records, environmental containment clearance audits, and atmospheric paint emission filings across candidate maintenance facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains hazardous chemical washdown and environmental containment clearance audits（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
EHS-HAZMAT-CG3：For Chateauroux Aviation Bay 7, the facility lacks active municipal discharge clearance for double-containment hazardous chemical recovery across its solvent stripping washdown and paint bay trench interceptors, meaning environmental chemical containment clearance is not met.
EHS-HAZMAT-CQQ：For Leipzig-Halle Overhaul Hall 2, active municipal discharge clearance for double-containment hazardous chemical recovery is in place for solvent stripping washdown and paint bay trench interceptors, satisfying environmental chemical containment clearance.
EHS-HAZMAT-TUW：For Shannon Airpark Hangar 4, solvent stripping washdown and paint bay trench interceptors hold active municipal discharge clearance for double-containment hazardous chemical recovery, confirming environmental chemical containment clearance.

information_points.title: Atmospheric paint emissions（VOC）
information_points.content:
EHS-VOC-TZN：Regarding atmospheric paint emissions at Shannon Airpark Hangar 4, the cumulative mass of atmospheric emissions from previous quarter painting and solvent extraction operations totaled 500 kg in quarterly volatile organic compound discharge.
EHS-VOC-C7O：Regarding atmospheric paint emissions at Chateauroux Aviation Bay 7, the cumulative mass of atmospheric emissions from previous quarter painting and solvent extraction operations totaled 420 kg in quarterly volatile organic compound discharge.
EHS-VOC-Y6I：Regarding atmospheric paint emissions at Leipzig-Halle Overhaul Hall 2, the cumulative mass of atmospheric emissions from previous quarter painting and solvent extraction operations totaled 350 kg in quarterly volatile organic compound discharge.
